decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends an established range and draws directly on the firm's in-house dairy know-how and its biodynamic farmer relationships, so management can read its early results well and refine it without much new knowledge.

The mild sliced cheese builds on the firm's own cheesemaking expertise and is presented on its own page, indicating active commitment, and one year is too short to judge it, so absorptive capacity favours continued learning and improvement.

Sliced butter cheese is closely related to the firm's existing cheese competence and has dedicated web presence, so the firm can assimilate market feedback and adjust it rather than withdraw it after only one year.
